name: Larry Dennis Hunnewell
summary: Larry Dennis Hunnewell was inducted into the U.S. Army on October 28, 1963 and separated on November 30, 1965 (both established by his DD-214); he served in Vietnam from approximately September 1964 until he was medevaced to Japan around early September 1965. While at Fort Benning he volunteered to go to Vietnam rather than receive an assignment to Turkey. He served as a radio operator, remembers his organization as the 118th AOD (Aviation Operations Detachment), recalls an association with the 1st Cavalry, and describes traveling extensively throughout Vietnam by helicopter.
larrysRecollection: Larry remembers his organization as the 118th AOD — Aviation Operations Detachment — a relatively small organization of approximately 110 men, including radio operators and pathfinders. Some personnel reportedly required special clearances. His duties involved substantial helicopter travel, and he recalls traveling throughout Vietnam.
researchNotes: Service dates, unit designation, and organizational relationships are remembered rather than documented. Verification against personnel records, morning reports, and unit histories is the central research task of this project.
